import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    p = int(data[2])
    b = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        b[i] = b[i >> 1] + (i & 1)

    def qpow(baseVal, y=p-2):
        res = 1
        while y:
            if y & 1:
                res = res * baseVal % p
            baseVal = baseVal * baseVal % p
            y >>= 1
        return res

    MAXN = n + 1
    x = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(27)]
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    invFact = [1] * (n + 1)

    def calc(depth, num):
        if b[num] < depth:
            return 0
        if depth == 1:
            return x[depth][num]
        if x[depth][num]:
            return x[depth][num]
        cnt = 0
        m = num
        while m:
            m = m & (m - 1)
            if b[m] >= depth - 1:
                x[depth][num] += calc(depth - 1, m) * x[num ^ m][num]
                cnt += 1
                if cnt == 18:
                    cnt = 0
                    x[depth][num] %= p
        x[depth][num] %= p
        return x[depth][num]

    def choose(n, m):
        return fact[n] * invFact[m] % p * invFact[n - m] % p

    base = qpow(k, n)
    if n & 1:
        print(base)
        return

    lim = min(k, b[n])
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % p
    invFact[n] = qpow(fact[n])
    for i in range(n - 1, 0, -1):
        invFact[i] = invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p

    result = 0
    for i in range(lim, 0, -1):
        result += choose(k, i) * calc(i, n)
    base = (base - result % p * fact[n] % p + p) % p
    print(base)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
